Run the governed M2-v2 C2 forecast path

Source: R/m2_v2_c2_governed.R
run_m2_v2_c2_governed_runtime.Rd

A timing failure abstains to the fitted type baseline. B +1 is always B1. B +2 remains B1 until a review object explicitly opens the artifact's exact causal gate version. This function does not alter run_prospective_pipeline().

Usage

run_m2_v2_c2_governed_runtime(
  artifact,
  weekly_data,
  origin_week,
  a_handoff = NULL,
  b_handoff = NULL,
  b_gate_review = NULL
)

Arguments

artifact

Validated governed M2-v2 C2 artifact.

weekly_data

Three or more typed weekly rows used by the research runtime adapter.

origin_week

Current week in season-relative coordinates.

a_handoff

Optional governed A M1 timing handoff.

b_handoff

Optional type-B soft-timing handoff.

b_gate_review

Optional reviewed gate opening from new_m2_v2_b_gate_review().

Value

Governed output contract with prediction rows and provenance.
